card.name: Digits inside dates and number ranges
card.fires_on: Responds to a digit or the space just before a digit while a year, date, or numeric range is being written, such as the middle digit of a lifespan year or the space before a temperature range.

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of a four-digit year in a birth-death span.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space just before a date or temperature range begins.

modes.label: Digit in a range or decimal
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside a temperature range or dose amount.
modes.example: The recommended pediatric dose is 0<<.>>5 g/kg arginine hydrochloride

card.writes: The promoted tokens are Chinese words for "when", "or" and "according to", so there is no clear link to the English contexts.
card.plain: It fires while a number such as a year, date or temperature range is being typed out, just before or inside its digits.
